name: check_github_activity
script:
# Get the profile safely from form_dict
github_user = frappe.form_dict.get("github_profile")
redirect_url = "/learning-guideline"

if github_user:
    try:
        # Use + for string building as .format is blocked in your environment
        url = "https://api.github.com/users/" + str(github_user) + "/events/public"
        
        # Fetch data using the built-in allowed method
        events = frappe.make_get_request(url)
        
        # Check if we got a list of events
        if events and isinstance(events, list):
            now = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
            recent_activity = False
            
            # Look at recent events
            for e in events[:10]:
                if e.get('type') == 'PushEvent':
                    # Parse date safely
                    created_at = frappe.utils.get_datetime(e.get('created_at'))
                    
                    # Use date_diff (returns difference in days)
                    if frappe.utils.date_diff(now, created_at) < 30:
                        recent_activity = True
                        break
            
            if recent_activity:
                redirect_url = "/bodhya-mentors"
                
    except Exception:
        # We can't use get_traceback, so we just log a simple message
        frappe.log_error("GitHub API call failed for user: " + str(github_user))
        redirect_url = "/learning-guideline"

# Return the message to the Client Script
frappe.response["message"] = redirect_url
